Kytkentäkaavio, ei mittakaavassa. Vasemm: Circuit diagram, not to scale. On the left is the Arduino board drawn as a box with two connections on its right edge: digital pin D8 above and ground GND below. From pin D8 a wire leads to the plus connection of the piezo buzzer. The buzzer is drawn as a box with a half circle, from whose curved side sound waves spread. The other connection of the buzzer returns to the Arduino's GND connection.
